dict.string: Snapreel uses the camera only while you record a camera video. Recordings stay on this iPhone.
Snapreel uses the microphone to record your voice with camera, screen and audio recordings. Recordings stay on this iPhone.
Snapreel saves the recordings you choose to your Photos library.
Snapreel opens your library only when you choose a video to import.
Snapreel turns the speech in your recordings into a transcript on this iPhone, so you can search it and jump to any line.
